capabilities.description: 执行已授权的币安 Spot 市价或限价单；内部并行准备账户/交易规则/报价，持久化 operation_id 后发送。

usage.purpose: 执行已授权的币安 Spot 市价或限价单；内部并行准备账户/交易规则/报价，持久化 operation_id 后发送。
usage.inputs: {operation_id:"spot-buy-001",environment:"testnet",symbol:"BTCUSDT",action:"limit",side:"buy",quantity:"0.001",limit_price:"50000",user_authorized:true}；quantity 是基础资产数量，限价单必须有 limit_price。
usage.outputs: {contract,backend,status,submissionAttempted,raw}；raw 保存 account、clientOrderId、真实订单状态/成交或安全错误。
prerequisites: Configure the selected environment and HMAC API key/secret through configuration_integration_apply.
Trading mutations require the authorized main conversation; configuration presence alone does not grant trading permission.
limitations: 同一 operation_id 只发送一次；未知结果先 binance_order_status，不能换 ID 盲目重下。
市价单的 price_limit 只约束发送前报价，不能保证实际成交价格；需要价格上限时使用 limit。
Spot 卖出使用已有基础资产；不做空、不接受 position_id/MT5 附加止损。portfolio-execution 当前只接 MT5/QMT，币安用本包工具。

usage.inputs: {binding,query:{account,instruments:[{sourceId,instrumentId}],range:{from:{basis:"utc",unixMs},to:{basis:"utc",unixMs}},scope?},page:{limit:100,cursor?}}；仅 working orders 可省略范围和品种。
usage.outputs: {items,nextCursor?,metadata:{coverage?,truncated?,meta,connection}}。单品种历史接口到 1000 条时标记截断，可缩小范围；分页结束不抹掉原生截断。
prerequisites: Configure the selected environment and HMAC API key/secret through configuration_integration_apply.
Trading mutations require the authorized main conversation; configuration presence alone does not grant trading permission.
limitations: Spot production and Spot Testnet are distinct identities. Futures, margin and withdrawals are outside this adapter.

configurationRequirements.reason: Select production or Spot Testnet; default is testnet.
Binance private account or trading operation.
HMAC signing for the selected Binance account.

prerequisites: Host lifecycle disposal only.
limitations: Spot production and Spot Testnet are distinct identities. Futures, margin and withdrawals are outside this adapter.

fields.title: 账户环境
fields.description: testnet 是 Spot 测试网，production 是币安生产现货；未配置默认 testnet。公开行情绑定可独立明确选择环境。

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: 所选环境的 HMAC API key。公开行情不需要；账户读取与交易权限由 Binance 验证。

fields.title: HMAC API Secret
fields.description: 所选环境的 HMAC secret；只用于原生签名，不写入插件账本或回执。
